## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` if this changes behaviour, security,
      compatibility, setup, the manifest or packaging.
- [ ] No test fixture contains rulebook text or real player data.
- [ ] If this touches the socket envelope or a procedure name, it is additive (see CONTRIBUTING).
